Definition: from G1909 and G2572; to conceal, i.e. (figuratively) forgive:--cover.
BiblicalUsage: Epikalypto means to cover — and Paul quotes the psalm: Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered. The covering is not hiding; it is forgiveness.
TheologicalSignificance: Covered sins are the only blessed ones, I hold: not sins denied, but sins forgiven and covered by God Himself.
